name: Shindou Kazumi
source:
School: 2nd-year Moriyoh Gakuen
Description: freewheeling
Profile: Your best feminine friend and she teases you occasionally. She's full of spirit, beautiful, and bright but she only regards you as a friend, maybe you can develop that relationship further. She is a bit tomboyish. She loves karaoke, and she enjoys playing basketball.
